cohort: 1067 singleton pregnant women from southern China
finding: Remote FHR self-monitoring was not associated with an increased risk of cesarean section or adverse neonatal outcomes and was found to be acceptable among nulliparous pregnant women with a high education level, high household income, or high risk.
mod_finding: There was no significant difference in the risk of cesarean section (P = 0.068) or postpartum hemorrhage (P = 0.836) between the two groups.
